Package sootup.callgraph.invokedynamic

Class BootstrapMethodHandleResolver

java.lang.Object
sootup.callgraph.invokedynamic.BootstrapMethodHandleResolver
All Implemented Interfaces:
DynamicInvokeResolver
public final class BootstrapMethodHandleResolver extends Object implements DynamicInvokeResolver
Resolves an invokedynamic call site to every method referenced by a MethodHandle among its bootstrap arguments. For LambdaMetafactory call sites that is the lambda body or method reference, marked as DynamicInvokeTarget.lambdaImplementation() so pointer analyses can bind captured values. Other bootstraps (e.g. ObjectMethods for records) contribute their method handles as plain targets.
